monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The flower checklist adds relevant product-neutral paths to the existing gear comparison, lockbox, and loupe decision tools without allowing a commercial link to determine the conclusion.

image_qa.note: The flower checklist, CBG evidence checker, and breadcrumb update use text, tables, controls, and existing design components. No product, cultivar, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 14–October 11 report showed 1,373 impressions, four clicks, 0.3% CTR, and average position 33.5. Stem Cell CBG was the only repeatable position 4–20 page signal with meaningful support: 18 impressions, one click, and position 6.2, so it received the one Data-led slot, a five-layer evidence checker, and reciprocal peer links. One-impression query rows and the isolated Oklahoma-law click at position 66.9 were deliberately ignored as too weak or irrelevant. Canonical and legacy sitemap errors or pending status also favored clearer sitewide breadcrumb identity and crawl paths instead of more isolated pages.

authority.action: Rebuilt the thin flower page into a citation-worthy twelve-point packaged-flower checkout and three-record comparison using current New York OCM consumer and laboratory materials plus FDA boundaries; connected it to freshness, COA, storage, and gear-decision pages; and added an evidence-literacy tool plus reciprocal links around Stem Cell CBG. No outreach was sent or logged because strengthening the on-site flower and CBG clusters was the higher-value authority action.
